page.overview:
Who is Cyruss Okent?

Cyruss Okent was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems. Okent was promoted to the rank alongside several others at a ceremony held at the Jedi Temple weeks after the beginning of the war Shortly thereafter, Okent was shipped out to join a clone battalion repelling a Separatist strike on Bracca, making them the only one of the new Knights to miss a reception held for the group in Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine's office the next day.

Cyruss Okent first appeared in the 2022 novel Brotherhood, written by Mike Chen.
